scope.input_structure: best USP15 AF2 positive seed for each R10 candidate

preparation.experimental_construct: tag-free USP15 DUSP and tag-free binder sequences
preparation.histidines: assign from local hydrogen-bond environment and record per system
preparation.termini: zwitterionic unless the experimental construct is chemically capped
preparation.missing_atoms: rebuild standard heavy atoms and hydrogens; do not model unresolved non-target domains

production.random_seed_policy: unique recorded seed for every system and replicate

analysis.alignment: USP15 DUSP chain B C-alpha atoms
metrics: USP15 DUSP backbone RMSD and RMSF
analysis.hydrogen_bond_definition: donor-acceptor distance <=3.5 A and donor-H-acceptor angle >=135 degrees
analysis.reporting: show each replicate and median with 95% bootstrap confidence interval; do not pool replicas before checking convergence
analysis.mm_gbsa: optional relative diagnostic on evenly spaced post-burn-in frames; never convert directly to KD and never use as the only advancement gate

prospective_triage_not_validated.purpose: prioritize experimental order, not claim binding
criteria: no persistent complex separation in any replicate
at least 70% of post-burn-in frames have binder RMSD <=3.0 A
at least four of six hotspot residues retain >=50% contact occupancy
